name: EventBridge Rule Persistence
description: An attacker with events:PutRule and events:PutTargets creates an EventBridge rule that triggers on a schedule (e.g., rate(5 minutes)) or event pattern. The target is a Lambda function or other resource that runs attacker code. The rule executes automatically without further attacker action, establishing persistence. The attacker may need lambda:AddPermission to allow EventBridge to invoke the Lambda. Required permissions are events:PutRule and events:PutTargets.
